institutions.regulator: CNBV, with CONDUSEF for consumer protection

depositInsurance.value: Up to 400,000 UDIs per person per bank (about MXN 3.4 million), by IPAB

institutions.creditBureau: Buró de Crédito / Círculo de Crédito
institutions.retirementSystem: Afore individual accounts, with voluntary contributions
institutions.unemploymentNote: There is no general unemployment insurance. You can make a partial unemployment withdrawal from your Afore, but it reduces your retirement savings.

cashAtHome.name: Cash at home (bajo el colchón)
cashAtHome.note: Loses value to inflation and can be lost or stolen.

everydayAccount.name: Debit account
everydayAccount.note: For payments and SPEI transfers, usually no interest.

savingsAccount.name: CETES (via cetesdirecto)
savingsAccount.note: Government treasury bills you can buy from 100 pesos; backed by the federal government.

indexFund.name: Index fund / ETF
indexFund.note: Broad index fund bought monthly. Value goes up and down; long-term average historically positive.

retirementProduct.name: Afore voluntary contributions
retirementProduct.note: Extra savings into your Afore; may give tax deductions.

informalSavings.name: Tanda
informalSavings.description: Friends or coworkers each pay a fixed amount every week or fortnight and take turns receiving the whole pot. No interest, and it depends on everyone paying.

bigLifeEvent.name: Quinceañera or wedding
bigLifeEvent.note: Big celebrations are important family moments and are often paid for with credit.

culture.familySupport: A cousin abroad lost their job and family back home needs support
notes: Many households save through tandas because of trust and habit.
Credit card CAT (total annual cost) is often very high.

scams.message: You have a pending tax debt. Download your invoice to avoid seizure: sat-gob-mx.info/factura.zip
scams.tell: SAT uses sat.gob.mx and the Buzón Tributario, never .zip downloads from other domains.

scams.message: Congratulations! You won a 10,000 peso gift card. Pay 299 pesos shipping to claim it.
scams.tell: Prizes you never entered for, plus a fee to claim them, are a scam.

scams.message: We have your cousin. Deposit 15,000 pesos at OXXO now and do not hang up.
scams.tell: Virtual kidnapping (extorsión telefónica): they keep you on the line so you cannot check. Hang up and call your relative. Report to 089.

scams.message: We detected a suspicious charge. To cancel it, read me your NIP and the code from your token.
scams.tell: Banks never ask for your NIP or token codes. Hang up and call the number on your card.

scams.message: SPEI transfer received: 1,200 pesos from Ana López, concept 'tanda week 3'.
scams.tell: A transfer notification inside your own app, with no request, is normal.

scams.message: Your complaint folio 2026-04817 has been received and assigned to an advisor.
scams.tell: A reply to a complaint you filed, from the official .gob.mx domain, with no payment request.
